name: PDF Metadata
description: Automatically writes metadata (Title, Author, Subject, Keywords) into uploaded PDF files, using entity tokens configured per file field, on entity insert/update.
library_dependencies: Ghostscript (system `gs` binary, default provider; regenerates the PDF via pdfwrite/pdfmark)
ExifTool (system libimage-exiftool-perl binary or the composer package phpexiftool/exiftool; optional provider that edits metadata in place and preserves interactive forms)

suggests.phpexiftool/exiftool: Required for ExifTool provider which preserves PDF interactive forms. System-wide ExifTool installation is recommended as alternative.

project_description: PDF Metadata extends Drupal's core File module so that metadata attributes (Title, Author, Subject, Keywords) can be written into uploaded PDF documents automatically. Each supported file field (or entity-reference field pointing at file-bearing entities such as media) gets per-field third-party settings where an editor configures token replacement patterns (for example [node:title]); when the host entity is inserted or updated, an event subscriber resolves those tokens against the entity and writes the resulting values into every attached PDF. Writing is delegated to a pluggable provider layer with two built-in providers: Ghostscript (default, regenerates the PDF and may flatten interactive form fields) and ExifTool (edits metadata in place, preserving fillable forms), with automatic fallback and an admin settings form that reports provider availability and lets an administrator set a custom ExifTool binary path and extra Ghostscript options.
